environment.timing: Same CUDA Graph per row. Single events enclose one replay; batched events enclose multiple replays.
environment.selector: Same fused min/max bound and topk; legacy and native metadata layouts produce identical ordered IDs.
limitations: Synthetic fixed Q/K/V and prediction IDs, not a recreation of model traces
Compilation, capture, KV expansion, metadata and prediction construction excluded
Replay timing can include host submission gaps and is not isolated kernel execution time
Batched statistics summarize per-replay batch means, not individual requests
